title: "Satan Doesn’t Want You to Read This – Exposing His Biggest Lies" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Satan Doesn’t Want You to Read This – Exposing His Biggest Lies" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Deception is everywhere. Are you being fooled?
Satan is called the father of lies (John 8:44), and he has been deceiving humanity since the beginning of time.
📖 “And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
🚨 He won’t come to you with red horns and a pitchfork—he comes disguised as truth.
💡 If you don’t know his strategies, you are at risk of falling for them.

🔥 1. Satan’s Goal: Keep You Blind to the Truth
The devil’s greatest weapon isn’t power—it’s deception.
📖 “Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.” (1 Peter 5:8)
💡 If you know his lies, you can defeat him with the truth!
🚨 Here are Satan’s biggest lies that are destroying lives today.

🔥 2. The Biggest Lies Satan Wants You to Believe
1️⃣ "There’s No Such Thing as Satan or Hell"
One of Satan’s greatest tricks is convincing people he doesn’t exist.
If people don’t believe in him, they won’t resist him.
📖 “The god of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel.” (2 Corinthians 4:4)
🚨 Truth: Satan is real. Hell is real. And without Jesus, people are headed there.

2️⃣ "You Have Plenty of Time to Get Right With God"
The devil loves procrastination—he convinces people to delay repentance.
Many die unexpectedly, still thinking they had ‘more time.’
📖 “You do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little time and then vanishes.” (James 4:14)
🚨 Truth: Tomorrow is not promised—repent and follow Jesus today!

3️⃣ "You Can Be a ‘Good Person’ Without Jesus"
Many believe “I’m a good person, so I’ll go to heaven.”
But NO ONE is good enough—only Jesus saves!
📖 “There is no one righteous, not even one.” (Romans 3:10)
🚨 Truth: Your good deeds can never save you—only faith in Jesus Christ can.

4️⃣ "You Can Live However You Want and Still Go to Heaven"
Many think they can live in sin and still inherit God’s Kingdom.
But the Bible is clear: A transformed life is proof of true faith.
📖 “Do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who practice homosexuality, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.” (1 Corinthians 6:9-10)
🚨 Truth: Real salvation produces real change—if Jesus saved you, your life will show it!

5️⃣ "All Religions Lead to God"
Many believe “all religions worship the same God.”
But Jesus Himself said there is ONLY ONE WAY to God.
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Truth: Jesus is the ONLY way to heaven. No religion, no good works—only Him.

6️⃣ "Sin Isn’t a Big Deal – God Will Forgive You Anyway"
Satan loves when people treat sin lightly and live carelessly.
He whispers, “It’s just a small sin, God won’t mind.”
📖 “Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase? By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?” (Romans 6:1-2)
🚨 Truth: Sin separates you from God—repent and walk in righteousness.

7️⃣ "The Bible is Outdated – Follow Your Own Truth"
Today’s world rejects the Bible and promotes “live your truth.”
Satan knows that when people stop reading the Word, they lose discernment.
📖 “The grass withers and the flowers fade, but the Word of our God stands forever.” (Isaiah 40:8)
🚨 Truth: The Bible is eternal—culture changes, but God’s Word never does.

🔥 3. How to Defeat Satan’s Lies
1️⃣ Know the Word of God
The Bible is your weapon against deception.
Jesus defeated Satan’s temptations by quoting Scripture.
📖 “Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God.” (Ephesians 6:17)
🚨 The more you know God’s Word, the harder it is for Satan to fool you.

2️⃣ Stay Close to Jesus in Prayer
Satan attacks weak Christians who don’t pray.
Prayer connects you to God and strengthens your spirit.
📖 “Pray without ceasing.” (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
🚨 A prayerless Christian is a powerless Christian!

3️⃣ Surround Yourself with Strong Believers
The enemy targets those who isolate themselves.
Fellowship with true believers will keep you strong in faith.
📖 “Encourage one another and build each other up.” (1 Thessalonians 5:11)
🚨 Lone Christians are easy prey—stay connected to the Body of Christ!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to stand in truth and reject Satan’s lies. I will live by God’s Word, walk in holiness, and boldly expose deception. I belong to Jesus, and Satan has no power over me!"

🔥 THE “EXPOSE SATAN” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Identify and reject any lies you’ve believed.
✅ Step 3: Encourage 3 friends to grow in truth and study God’s Word.

🌌 SATAN IS A LIAR – DON’T FALL FOR HIS TRICKS 🌌
📖 “You shall know the truth, and the truth shall set you free.” (John 8:32)

👉 The only way to defeat Satan’s deception is to know the truth.
👉 Are you ready to expose the enemy and walk in victory?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Open my eyes to see the truth and reject every lie of the enemy. Fill me with discernment so I will not be deceived. Strengthen my faith, deepen my love for Your Word, and help me to boldly expose the devil’s tactics. I belong to You, Lord—keep me in Your truth!
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
